headline: Molten Core in 33:16, the first of three raids in one night, with two boss deaths

mvp.headline: the most damage on five of the ten bosses and no deaths
why: First on Lucifron, Magmadar, Baron Geddon, Golemagg and Ragnaros, second on Gehennas, Garr and Sulfuron
Parse 94 or higher on nine of ten bosses
Then the most damage on Broodlord, Ebonroc and Nefarian in Blackwing Lair the same night

also.text: 164 dispels, twice the next healer: 86 Ancient Dreads, 13 Ignite Manas and 6 Impending Dooms
tanked eight bosses including Ragnaros, where he took all 63 Elemental Fires, and parsed 96 on Garr and Majordomo
19 curses removed (7 Lucifron's, 6 Gehennas', 6 Shazzrah's) with Imnevermor's 18

overview: The first leg of a night that also cleared Blackwing Lair and Ahn'Qiraj. Molten Core took 33:16 for ten kills on ten pulls, against a usual 44:48 and the guild's best of 29:44. Two boss deaths: Emanuelxxion in Orbywan's Living Bomb on Geddon and Suintila to fire on the ground at Majordomo.
The raid came in buffed (28 of 39 with Rallying Cry and Zandalar, 26 with Sayge's Fortune, a Darkmoon week), and seven of the ten bosses finished within six seconds of the guild's fastest kill.
Trash cost nine deaths, three of them to Core Hounds and two to a Firesworn's Eruption.

wentWell.text: 4 of Sulfuron's 6 Dark Mendings kicked, by Roguina, Nessla, Suintila and Groomz.
16 Ignite Manas dispelled on Geddon, 9 of them by Eînherjer.
Gehennas in 0:20, one second off the guild's best.
Majordomo in 0:41, one second off the best, with 45k healing each from Phemmy and Foggiie.

notes.text: 0:27 (median 0:37), no deaths. 27 Impending Dooms dispelled, 9 Lucifron's Curses removed (Orbywan 7).
0:34 without deaths, but Lava Breath reached 34 raiders for 55k, where on a usual kill it hits nobody: the breath came round to the raid at least once.
140 Lava Bomb fire hits, 3.5 per raider against a usual 2.0, mostly melee (Thornhild 12, Tochopolvo and Eïnherjar 11). 2 Frenzies, 1 tranquilized.
0:20, no deaths. 14 Gehennas' Curses removed (Imnevermor 6, Orbywan 5, Skoomael 3). Rain of Fire hits a little over the usual rate, 79 on 25 raiders.
0:32 (median 0:47), no deaths. Eduard top at 1465/s, Sneakycatto parse 98.
0:36. Orbywan and Salma were the Living Bombs; Orbywan's killed Emanuelxxion at 0:21, and five raiders were caught in an explosion. Explosion damage ran three times the usual rate.
0:15 (best 0:14), no deaths. Alanakos top at 1798/s, parse 97.
0:36 (median 0:50), no deaths, 4 of 6 priest heals kicked.
0:43 (median 0:54), no deaths. Raid damage 26.5k a second, the highest of the raid. Gertggs 85k.

0:41. Suintila died to fire at 0:22. Blast Wave and the adds' Damage Shield both ran about five times the usual rate, so melee kept hitting into the shields (Tochopolvo, Lebh and Labwar took the most).
0:54 (median 1:08, best 0:41), no deaths. Macharius tanked through 63 Elemental Fires. Lava Burst hits were slightly above the usual rate.
